0x000843.en: 「At my current level...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x00093C.en: 「Damn it! Next time you won't get me!」

0x0009B6.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000A9D.en: 「Oh dear...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000B66.en: 「Guh! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000BA1.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　Not funny...」

0x000BF5.en: 「Blew it...!@　Guess I've got no choice but to bail...」

0x000D46.en: 「This is it for me...... the rest is up to you.」

0x000DF2.en: 「No good, I've taken too many hits...... I'm retreating!」

0x000E3F.en: 「Well, this is trouble. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E7D.en: 「Kyah! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000EC4.en: 「To think... the Granzon would be shot down...」

0x000F6F.en: 「Ngh...... To think I'd become a shooting star...... I'm ejecting!」

0x001026.en: 「Ow ow ow...... I give up, miscalculation on my part.」

0x001067.en: 「Well now, I've gone and gotten myself beat!」

0x001118.en: 「Tch! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00115F.en: 「I'm sorry. The rest is up to you.」

0x001280.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still not ready...!」

0x0012CE.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x0013B8.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013F6.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x001425.en: 「I can't do any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x0014B0.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll have to withdraw...!」

0x0016D4.en: 「Guaah! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001968.en: Kirkus Army Sodium-class Mobile Fortress - Bridge

0x0019A8.en: 「...I see. If it's going to take more time@ to arrange our return to the surface, then it seems we can earn a bit more coin.」

0x001A59.en: 「Something like that...@ Our job is to operate the units our employer entrusts to us@ and collect data from them.」

0x001AE3.en: 「Combat data sells especially high.@ So fighting here has real benefits for us.@ Though it means nothing unless we get back to the surface.」

0x001BAD.en: 「There is one condition for taking on this job.」

0x001C06.en: 「I wish to avoid contact with the Steel Dragon Squadron.@ If we happen to meet as enemies, so be it, but...」

0x001C8A.en: 「I would rather not reveal our identity by, say,@ taking part in the same operation.」

0x001CEF.en: 「...I see. So your existence and your actions@ are illegal on the surface.」

0x001D54.en: 「Correct.@ And let me give you a word of warning...」

0x001D95.en: 「Those Neue DC types we saw on the way here...@ Oleg, was it? If you intend to use them too,@ best not let them know about the Steel Dragons.」

0x001E52.en: 「They might well strike at you@ before the Shutedonias army does.」

0x001EAE.en: 「...I'll keep that in mind. I accept your condition.@　Wait at the point we designate for you.」

0x001F73.en: (Araceli, Oleg...@ I wonder if they can really replace Yang Long and the others...)

0x002000.en: 「A patrol along our ship's course, you say?」

0x002028.en: 「Yes. This area's within Kirkus territory,@ but with people like Shu and Saphine prowling about,@ caution seems warranted.」

0x0020F2.en: 「Hmm... You're saying there may be enemies@ hard to detect on radar.」

0x00215D.en: 「Louzorl, for instance, uses concealment arts,@ so we can only sense his presence@ from the faintest of clues.」

0x00221E.en: 「Disturbances in the surrounding environment, or the presence of malice.」

0x00225B.en: 「Then a unit equipped with the <T-LINK System>...@ one with high mobility as well...@ Lieutenant Ryusei's ART-1 would be ideal.」

0x00231D.en: 「We'll send out Gennacy.@ His Jaohm has excellent mobility too.」

0x0023BF.en: 「Understood.@ Still, that Jaohm sure is cool.@ Kind of resembles the Cybuster too.」

0x002446.en: 「This is Langran's first true Elemental unit...@ the machine Masaki first piloted, in fact.」

0x002508.en: 「A reading on the T-LINK sensor...!@ Straight ahead!」

0x002555.en: 「You're saying it's an enemy?@ There's nothing on the spirit radar.」

0x0025A5.en: 「But this feeling, I know it...!@ Dragon 2, this is ART-1!@ We might've hit the jackpot right off the bat!」

0x002651.en: 「Let's confirm, just in case.@ All hands, battle stations one. Full speed ahead, both engines.」

0x0026B3.en: 「Is this the spot...? Anything on radar?」

0x0026F0.en: 「Nothing, but...@ I'm picking up strange ground tremors.@ Doesn't seem to be an earthquake.」

0x002781.en: 「I'll try a warning shot at the tremor zone.@ Main gun six, ready to fire.」

0x0027D4.en: 「Understood. Main gun six, ready to fire.」

0x002844.en: 「...To notice us...@ I'll grant you that much credit.」

0x0028C2.en: 「Well, I can hide no longer.@ I'll drop the technique now.」

0x002947.en: 「Tch, so we couldn't change course in time.」

0x002987.en: 「Then, Major Kanzort Jog...@ I'll take my leave here.」

0x0029D7.en: 「Wait, Louzorl!@ ...Tch, that bastard... and calling me@ by my full name, no less.」

0x002A9E.en: 「What of it?@ To win, I'll use any means necessary.」

0x002AF7.en: 「If you've pushed this far in with concealment arts...@ then could your real target be the Kirkus main force?」

0x002B81.en: 「Now that I've been found out, there's no helping it.@ Either way, I'd have to take you all down.@ I'll settle things right here!」

0x002C26.en: 「All units, sortie at once! Return fire!」

0x002C5A.en: 「Break through them and reach Kirkus!@ Steel yourselves!」

0x002CB3.en: 「Grr! To be pushed back after coming this far!@ I've no intention of dying like a dog! Retreat!」

0x002D31.en: 「All enemy signals in the combat zone have vanished.」

0x002D68.en: 「To think Louzorl is lending Shutedonias@ a hand...」

0x002DC1.en: 「His goal is the revival of Volkruss, right?@ Why would he help Shutedonias?」

0x002E3E.en: 「Their interests must have aligned.@ The longer Langran's turmoil drags on,@ the easier Louzorl and his lot can move.」

0x002ED4.en: 「But if Volkruss revives,@ Shutedonias won't get off easy either.」

0x002F4B.en: 「Right. It may be they've only joined hands temporarily@ to achieve their immediate goals...」

0x002FC2.en: 「...Captain, a Kirkus army Elemental unit is approaching.@ They're requesting contact with us.」

0x00303C.en: 「Understood.@ Let's move to meet them halfway.」

0x003095.en: 「Do you understand what lending Louzorl your aid@ will bring about!?」

0x003103.en: 「Volkruss's revival?@ Hmph, evil god or not, I'll use it...@ to force Langran to its knees!」

0x0031A8.en: 「But it will bring calamity down@ on Shutedonias as well!」

0x00320A.en: 「Don't think that oversized hunk of junk@ can take on Valsione!」

0x003272.en: 「A big machine's got a big machine's way of moving!@ I won't fall behind some joke of a contraption!」

0x0032FB.en: 「Quite the fancy machine!@ Honestly, I can't figure out what you surface folk@ are even thinking!」

0x00337F.en: 「Then learn it with your own body!@ The sword-spirit forged into my DyGenGuard!」

0x0033F3.en: 「What kind of joke is that machine supposed to be?@ Besides, this is no place for a child!」

0x003452.en: 「I won't let you insult@ my Fairlion!」

0x00349F.en: 「Do you really think that man... Louzorl@ would cooperate without an ulterior motive?」

0x0034F8.en: 「Whatever he's scheming...@ so long as our army wins this war,@ that's all that matters!」

0x003579.en: 「Chasing short-term gains,@ you'd throw this world into chaos!?」

0x0035CC.en: 「The source of the chaos is Langran!@ I won't be lectured by surface dwellers!」

0x003655.en: 「Oh ho, that movement...@ Looks like you might give me a real fight!」

0x0036A8.en: 「Don't think a mobile fortress@ can stop me...!」

0x0036FB.en: 「Captain,@ we have visual confirmation of the Kirkus army's Elemental unit.」

0x003748.en: 「All stop, both engines. Hold at altitude 50 on TD.」

0x00377F.en: 「...Seems there was no need@ for us to come to the rescue.」

0x0037EE.en: 「Yang Long, it's been a while.@ It's Zashford.」

0x003841.en: 「Zash!?@ You've changed! Two years, is it?@ I had no idea you'd joined the army.」

0x0038AA.en: 「These are the times we live in.@ ...By the way, my father is heading here too.」

0x003931.en: 「Yes. When we learned fighting had broken out here,@ we came out ahead as an advance party, but...」

0x0039E5.en: 「Boy...!?@ You're not so different from me, you know.@ I'm eighteen.」

0x003A5A.en: 「Oh. So you're older, then.@ Sorry, you just seemed a little unreliable.」

0x003B26.en: 「...My name's Zashford.@ You can call me Zash. And you?」

0x003BA0.en: 「? Suddenly all sweet-talking... well, whatever.@ I'm Lune Zoldark.」

0x003C61.en: 「Th-that robot you pilot... it's pretty cool.」

0x003CCC.en: 「I mean it. It's cute, just like you.」

0x003D2E.en: 「Zashford!@　Quit your shameless flirting.@　If you're a man, hit 'em hard, hit 'em HARD!」

0x003E04.en: 「Yang Long, well done.@　That Stedonias unit just now was after me,@　wasn't it?」

0x003EA4.en: 「...Before you ask your questions,@　there's something I must tell you.」

0x003EFA.en: 「I've formed an alliance with Prince Feil.@　On the condition that Prince Terius takes the throne.」

0x003FAF.en: 「I know it's reckless.@　But I couldn't abandon my dream.」

0x004026.en: 「My dream of uniting Langran with my own hands...@　and then all of <La Gias>」

0x0040B8.en: 「General, you disregard the people's feelings too much.@　Prince Feil did nothing so grievous,@　yet you'd override the line of succession...」

0x004181.en: 「The people's feelings aren't the issue now.@　How swiftly Langran can be restored...@　that is what matters most.」

0x004220.en: 「And so you seize real power...@　then use restored Langran's strength@　to unite La Gias. Is that it...」

0x0042C2.en: 「Correct.@　It's the surest way to keep the peace lasting.@　Yang Long, I want your help too.」

0x00434F.en: 「All of it... to bring peace and a future to La Gias.」

0x0043D7.en: 「To sum up what you're saying,@　it all boils down to world conquest.」

0x004439.en: 「That's not it. I only seek peace...」

0x004473.en: 「You can't fool me with words.@　Dress it up however you like, it's the same thing.」

0x0044E1.en: 「Besides, your eyes look@　just like my old man's.」

0x004553.en: 「My old man said the same kind of thing,@　and in the end he failed. He leaned too hard on power,@　and lost to an even greater one.」

0x004601.en: 「The bigger the power you gain,@　the more you want to lean on it. But really,@　there's got to be a better way than relying on force.」

0x0046C4.en: 「It's because you have power@　that you can't see it.@　Right now you're just drunk on what you've got.」

0x004766.en: 「Ho, Lune...@　I never took you for one so sharp.」

0x0047BF.en: 「A wise hawk hides its Kirkus... er, claws. Never mind.」

0x0047FF.en: 「...I was a fool to be impressed.」

0x00482D.en: 「I understand what you're trying to say.@　But I won't change my methods.@　This is the conclusion I reached after much anguish.」

0x0048CF.en: 「Even if I'm branded a traitor now,@　history will prove@　my actions were right.」

0x004953.en: 「Only if you succeed.@　Far more people vanish from history@　than are remembered as heroes.」

0x0049E3.en: 「General, as I've said before,@　as a Machine God pilot I have my duty and my obligations.@　I can't let your actions slide.」

0x004A9A.en: 「...In other words, you'll fight me... is that it.」

0x004AE7.en: 「Understood. By rights,@　I ought to kill you all here and now, but...」

0x004B59.en: 「It seems I can't be that ruthless.@　We did fight side by side, after all.」

0x004BC7.en: 「We're about to launch a major offensive@　against Stedonias alongside Feil's army.@　Once that's done, we'll settle this between us.」

0x004C75.en: 「...I'll join the offensive against Stedonias.@　But I have one request...」

0x004CFE.en: 「Whatever comes of this,@　please send the Steel Dragon Squadron back to the surface.@　They are... victims in all this.」

0x004DA9.en: 「No need to worry about that.@ The return spell is being prepared@ at Seb Temple in Ballantine Province.」

0x004E36.en: 「If the surface-dwellers wish it, they may use it anytime.」

0x004E7F.en: 「I see, that's good to hear.@　Then, General... this is goodbye.」

0x004ED8.en: 「Mm. 'Take care' hardly fits here.@　Let's just wish each other well.」

0x004F3D.en: 「...Colonel Lefina, let's head for Seb Temple.」

0x004FA8.en: 「Yes. Once word spreads that the return spell@ is nearly ready, someone may show up@ scheming to seize Seb Temple.」

0x00507B.en: 「Father... I think your plan is@　wrong too.@　Why won't Prince Feil do?」

0x005114.en: 「...Zashford, I'm assigning you@　to support duty behind the lines. If I should fall...@　look after your mother and Remia.」

0x0051DE.en: 「Call it mixing duty and family, if you like.@ My family matters to me too, but I must@ answer for many more lives than just theirs...」

0x005292.en: 「Zashford, you'll protect your mother and the others@　in my place. This... is an order.」

0x005306.en: 「Wh-why won't you explain it to me!?@　I...」

0x005356.en: 「There's no need to explain to a mere foot soldier.」

0x005396.en: 「No!　@　Father, I'm not a child anymore!」

0x0053E6.en: 「...That's exactly what makes you a child.」

0x005414.en: 「Detain Second Lieutenant Zashford at once.@　Remove him by force.」

0x005486.en: （Zashford... I don't ask you to understand.@　But I will never allow you to die before me...）
